name: io.github.hlplanet/hlplanet-mcp
title: HLPlanet Keyboard Sizes
description: Compare keyboard sizes and 30 real keyboards, check desk and mousepad fit, search HLPlanet reviews.

tools.name: list_keyboard_sizes
tools.description: List the standard keyboard sizes (full-size 100%, 98%/1800, TKL 80%, 75%, 65%, 60%) with key count, typical dimensions, the keys each one drops compared to full-size, and who it suits. Use it for general questions like "what keyboard sizes are there" or "which size should I get".

tools.name: compare_keyboards
tools.description: Compare two to six keyboard sizes or real keyboards side by side: width, depth, key count, the keys each one is missing compared to the first, and how much desk / mouse room you gain. Accepts sizes ("TKL", "75%", "60") and keyboards reviewed on HLPlanet ("Wooting 60HE v2", "MCHOSE Jet 75"). Known keyboards: Redragon K761 Pro, Epomaker Galaxy100, NuPhy Air100 V3, ATK x QK Hex80, Wooting 80HE, GamaKay TK75 TMR, Yunzii RT75, NuPhy Kick75, Epomaker HE75 Mag, IQUNIX EZ75, Varmilo Minilo 75, Epomaker HE75 V2 TMR, DrunkDeer G75, MCHOSE Jet 75, XVX L75 Air, NuPhy Air75 V3, Keychron K3 HE, NuPhy Air75 HE, Keydous AJ68-CP, Epomaker HE65 V2 TMR, MCHOSE Ace 68 GT, Melgeek Made68 Ultra V2, Weikav NUT65, Varmilo Muse65 HE, Wooting 60HE v2, XVX Trooper63 HE, Epomaker Hack 59, Wooting 60HE+, IQUNIX EV63, DrunkDeer G60.

keyboards.description: The keyboards to compare. The first is the baseline the others are measured against. Use size names such as TKL or 75%, or keyboard models such as Wooting 80HE.

iso.description: Use the ISO layout (UK/EU, tall Enter, extra key by left Shift). Default ANSI.

tools.name: get_keyboard_dimensions
tools.description: Measured case dimensions (width x depth) of keyboards reviewed on HLPlanet. Search by name ("NuPhy Air75"), list every keyboard of one size ("75%"), or leave both empty to list all of them. Returns each match with its size, width and depth in cm and inches, and a link to its review; if the query names a size instead of a keyboard, returns the typical size of that layout.

query.description: Keyboard name or part of it, e.g. "Wooting" or "Jet 75"

size.description: List only keyboards of this layout size.

tools.name: check_desk_fit
tools.description: Check whether a keyboard and mousepad fit side by side on a desk. The keyboard is placed with its B key in front of the screen centre (move it with keyboard_offset_cm). Returns the mouse room left, whether the pad fits or how far it hangs off, how far the mouse sits from the screen centre, and whether a full 360-degree turn at the given sensitivity (cm/360) fits on the pad.

keyboards.description: The keyboards to place on the desk, as size names (TKL, 75%) or keyboard models. Each one is checked on its own.

desk_width_cm.description: Usable width of the desk surface in centimetres (inches x 2.54).

mousepad.description: Mousepad preset. In cm: small 25x21, medium 36x30, large 45x40, xl 49x42; a deskmat (90x40) sits under both keyboard and mouse. Use custom together with mousepad_width_cm.

mousepad_width_cm.description: Width of a custom mousepad in centimetres.

cm_per_360.description: Mouse sensitivity as cm of movement for a full 360 turn

left_handed.description: Mouse on the left of the keyboard

keyboard_offset_cm.description: How far to shift the keyboard sideways from the centred position, in cm. Negative shifts it left, positive right.

tools.name: which_sizes_have_key
tools.description: Check which keyboard sizes have a key or key group, e.g. "Delete", "F5", "Insert", "Print Screen", "backtick", "arrow keys", "numpad", "function keys". Returns, for each standard size from 100% to 60%, whether it has the key: yes, partly (how many keys of the group) or no. Sizes without it usually reach it through an Fn layer.

key.description: The key or key group to look up, named the way people usually call it: Delete, F12, Home, arrow keys, numpad.

iso.description: Use the ISO layout (UK/EU, tall Enter, extra key by left Shift). Default ANSI.

tools.name: search_hlplanet
tools.description: Search HLPlanet.com, a review site for Hall effect, TMR and rapid trigger keyboards, gaming controllers and gaming gear. Returns the titles and links of matching reviews, comparisons and guides, not the article text.

query.description: Search terms: a keyboard or controller model, a brand or a topic, e.g. "Wooting 80HE" or "low profile hall effect".

tools.name: list_testing_tools
tools.description: List free browser tools from HLPlanet for testing keyboards and controllers: keyboard tester (every key, rollover, chatter, rapid trigger, SOCD / Snap Tap), gamepad and stick drift tester, controller reaction time test and keyboard size comparison. The testers run in a web browser with a person at the keyboard or controller.
